team.title: Team

team.fullAdminAccess: Full admin access (bypasses all permission checks)
team.deleteRoleDescription: Delete the "{name}" role? Members with this role will lose their custom permissions.
team.noCustomRoles: No custom roles yet. Create one to define granular permissions for team members.

team.adminDescription: Can invite/remove members and manage shared data.

team.removeMemberDescription: Remove {name} from the team? They will lose access to shared data.
team.technicianHint: Can be assigned jobs and use the technician app
team.setupAppInstruction: Ask {name} to do this on their phone:
team.setupAppExpired: This code has expired. Close and start again.
team.setupAppFailed: Could not create a setup code
team.setupPageBody: Open Torqvoice Tech on this phone, tap Scan setup code, and point it at the same code again.
team.setupPageCode: Or type this code in the app
team.setupPageExpiry: This code works once and expires ten minutes after your workshop created it.
team.setupAppStep2: Open it and tap “Scan setup code”
team.setupAppStep3: Point the phone at this code
team.setupAppNotCamera: The phone's own camera app will not work. It has to be scanned from inside Torqvoice Tech.
team.addTechnicianHint: For a mechanic standing at the counter. No email, no waiting.
team.addTechnicianNote: They sign in with that number from then on. No password to remember, and nothing to type on the app’s first screen.
team.addTechnicianDone: {name} is set up. Show them the code.
team.revokeTechnicianTitle: Sign them out of the app?
team.revokeTechnicianBody: {name} loses access on their phone straight away, and any code they have stops working. Their finished work and hours stay exactly as they are.
team.addPersonWho: These two are set up in different ways, so start by telling us which one this is.
team.choiceTechnicianHint: Works on the cars and uses Torqvoice on their phone. Easiest to do while they are standing here with you, and it takes about a minute.
team.choiceMemberHint: Books cars in, orders parts and sends invoices, on a computer. You send them an email and they pick their own password.
team.techDetailsBlurb: The mobile number is how they sign in from now on, so use the phone they actually carry. There is no password for them to remember or forget.
team.techHandoffTitle: Now get it onto their phone
team.techHandoffBlurb: This code joins their phone to your workshop. It works once, and only for the next ten minutes, so do it while they are here.
team.memberDetailsBlurb: They get an email with a link. When they open it they choose their own password, and then they appear in the list above.
team.roleHint: Admins can change settings and add people. Everyone else does the day-to-day work.
team.stepDoneBody: They can open the app and see their jobs. Next time they sign in it is just their mobile number, no code needed.
team.stepInvitedBody: They will show up in the list once they have opened the email and accepted. The link works for seven days.
team.clashBlurb: Two people cannot share a mobile number, because it is what they sign in with. Which of these is it?
team.clashSamePersonHint: The same person coming back, or a name spelled differently. Their jobs and hours stay with them, and the name you just typed replaces the old one.
team.clashTakeoverHint: A different person who now has that number. {name} keeps everything they did here but can no longer sign in, and you can give them a new number later.
team.clashDifferentNumber: Neither, let me change the number
team.workshopCountry: Which country is your workshop in?
team.workshopCountryHint: Asked once. After this, mobile numbers can be typed the short way. You can change it later in <link>Localisation settings</link>.
team.choiceStandalone: A name for the board only
team.choiceStandaloneHint: An apprentice, a contractor, anyone you schedule but who never signs in. No phone, no email, no account. You can give them one later.
team.standaloneDetailsBlurb: This is all they get, and all they need. They appear on the work board and on jobs, and there is nothing for them to sign into.
team.stepStandaloneBody: You can schedule them and put them on jobs straight away. If they ever need the app, add a mobile number to them from this list.
team.boardOnlyHint: Scheduled and put on jobs, but they never sign in. Give them a mobile number when they need the app.
team.giveAppBlurb: A mobile number is all that is missing. They sign in with it from then on.
team.giveAppKeepsHistory: Everything already recorded against them stays where it is.
team.inviteMemberHint: They get an email and choose their own password.
team.removeBoardOnlyBody: {name} stops appearing on the work board and can no longer be put on jobs. Work already recorded against them, and the hours they clocked, stay exactly as they are.
team.noRolesYet: This workshop has no roles yet, so there is nothing to give them beyond Admin. Create the standard ones and narrow the permissions later.
team.noRoleDescription: No permissions at all. They can sign in and every screen will refuse them until you give them a role below.
team.cannotUseApp: Their role cannot work on jobs. Give them Technician, or a role with the same permissions, first.
team.revokeTechnicianDone: {name} has been signed out of the app
team.noAccessBody: Your account is part of {workshop}, but it has not been given a role, so there is nothing here you can open yet. Ask an owner or an admin at your workshop to give you one.

tax.title: Tax
tax.description: Configure the tax rate applied to invoices, quotes, and work orders.
tax.modeHint: Choose whether prices on line items are entered with tax already included (inclusive) or before tax (exclusive). Existing records keep the mode they were created with.
tax.modeInclusiveExample: Example: $100 entered already includes {rate}% tax — the tax portion is reverse-calculated.
tax.labelHint: Custom name shown on invoices and quotes (e.g. VAT, GST, MVA, MwSt.). Leave blank to use the localized default.
tax.convertInclusiveLabel: Convert existing records to inclusive mode
tax.convertInclusiveHint: Scales every line item price upward by the tax rate so prices include tax. Customer-facing totals stay the same. Eligible: {serviceRecords} work orders, {quotes} quotes.
tax.convertInclusiveConfirmTitle: Convert existing records to inclusive mode?
tax.convertInclusiveConfirmDescription: This will rewrite line item prices on {serviceRecords} work orders and {quotes} quotes so they include tax. Customer-facing totals will not change, but the printed prices on past invoices will appear higher. This cannot be undone.
tax.convertInclusiveSuccess: Converted {serviceRecords} work orders and {quotes} quotes to inclusive mode.
tax.convertInclusiveFailed: Failed to convert records to inclusive mode
tax.convertExclusiveLabel: Convert existing records to exclusive mode
tax.convertExclusiveHint: Scales every line item price downward by the tax rate so prices show pre-tax amounts. Customer-facing totals stay the same. Eligible: {serviceRecords} work orders, {quotes} quotes.
tax.convertExclusiveConfirmTitle: Convert existing records to exclusive mode?
tax.convertExclusiveConfirmDescription: This will rewrite line item prices on {serviceRecords} work orders and {quotes} quotes so they show pre-tax amounts. Customer-facing totals will not change, but the printed prices on past invoices will appear lower. This cannot be undone.
tax.convertExclusiveSuccess: Converted {serviceRecords} work orders and {quotes} quotes to exclusive mode.
tax.convertExclusiveFailed: Failed to convert records to exclusive mode

currency.defaultTaxRateHint: Auto-populated when creating new service records

currency.applyTaxConfirmDescription: This will set the tax rate to {rate}% on {serviceRecords} work orders and {quotes} quotes that currently have no tax rate, and recalculate their totals. Records with a custom tax rate will not be changed. This cannot be undone.
currency.applyTaxFailed: Failed to apply tax to existing records
currency.applyTaxNoRecords: No records need the default tax rate applied.

backupStatus.title: Data Protection
backupStatus.description: We take your data seriously. All of your organization's data, including customers, vehicles, work orders, invoices and uploaded files, is automatically backed up every hour. Backups are protected with AES-256 encryption before they leave our infrastructure and are stored at a separate, secure location, so no outside party can read them.

webhooks.subtitle: Send real-time event notifications to your own systems via HTTPS. Each event is signed with HMAC-SHA256 so you can verify authenticity.
webhooks.createDescription: Webhooks are POSTed as JSON. Failed deliveries are retried with exponential backoff up to 5 times.

webhooks.eventsHint: Choose which events trigger this webhook.
webhooks.statusFailing: {count, plural, one {# recent failure} other {# recent failures}}
webhooks.confirmRotateDescription: The current secret will stop working immediately. Update your endpoint with the new secret.
webhooks.secretRotatedDescription: Save this secret now — it cannot be recovered later.
webhooks.confirmDeleteDescription: “{name}” will stop receiving events immediately. This cannot be undone.
webhooks.secretShownOnceDescription: Copy this signing secret now. It will not be shown again.
webhooks.secretCopyHint: Use this secret to verify the X-Torqvoice-Signature header on each request.
webhooks.deliveriesDescription: Last 50 attempts. Failed events are retried automatically with exponential backoff.
webhooks.deliveriesEmpty: No deliveries yet. Send a test event to try it out.
webhooks.emptyDescription: Add a webhook to push events to your own systems — accounting sync, custom dashboards, Zapier, anything that speaks HTTP.
webhooks.helpIntro: Each delivery includes an HMAC-SHA256 signature so you can confirm the request came from Torqvoice.
webhooks.helpVerify: Reconstruct the signed string as `[timestamp].[body]` and compare with timing-safe equality:
webhooks.autoDisabledBanner: This webhook was auto-paused after 20 consecutive failures. Re-enable to resume deliveries.
webhooks.referenceIntro: Every delivery follows this envelope shape. Click an event to see a sample payload your endpoint will receive.

serviceRequest.title: Service request alerts
serviceRequest.description: Service requests submitted through the customer portal always show up in the notification bell. Turn this on to also get them by email.

serviceRequest.recipientsHint: Leave empty to notify every owner and admin. Separate several addresses with commas.
serviceRequest.emailSetupHint: Alerts are sent with your configured mail provider.

lowStock.title: Low stock alerts
lowStock.description: Alerts when a part reaches its reorder point. A part is low when its quantity drops to or below its "Min Qty", or the default below if it has none. Each part is reported once per dip and stays quiet until it is restocked.
lowStock.enableHint: Off by default. Only parts with a reorder point set are watched.
lowStock.inAppHint: One grouped notification in the bell, not one per part.
